author: Ananya Sharma
comment: Being able to order Butter Chicken from Spice Route AND a Truffle Burger from BurgerCraft in a SINGLE delivery bag is black magic! Arrived steaming hot in 22 minutes.

author: Rohan Deshmukh
comment: The live order tracking page is so clean. You can actually see when your food leaves the wok station vs when it gets packed. Total gamechanger.

author: Priya Nair
comment: Bowlful & Co. is my daily lunch default. Healthy grain bowls that actually taste rich and fresh. Glass packaging is super premium.
